newsitem.title: USA: TCF Financial closes Chicago bank purchase.
newsitem.headline: TCF Financial closes Chicago bank purchase.

text.p: TCF Financial Corp said Friday its TCF Bank Illinois fsb subsidiary has completed the acquisition of BOC Financial Corp, a Chicago savings bank holding company owning the Bank of Chicago s.b.
TCF said the Bank of Chicago acquisition will greatly enhance its branch network within the city limits of Chicago.
Bank of Chicago has about $185 million in assets and three offices.

The three offices will continue to operate under the Bank of Chicago name until TCF receives final approval for a national bank charter, expected sometime this spring. At that time, all branches in Illinois will become TCF National Bank Illinois and operate under the trade name of TCF Bank.
TCF agreed in June to purchase BOC Financial for cash. Regulatory approval from the Office of Thrift Supervision was granted on December 27, 1996.
TCF Bank Illinois fsb, with headquarters in Oak Brook, is one of four savings bank subsidiaries of TCF.
